notes.title: Leaving Early Access with the Purgatory Update
notes.notes:
The Purgatory Update is here for To Hell With Hell, expanding the games content and story with a new biome and a new massive boss which will hopefully make some players suffer in hell for some time.

The new boss was included into the main part and will definitely bring some further challenges into the hellfire bullet hell. Of course, to fight it, you'll need some new weapons to defeat this monster. Which is why a new load of guns have been added. And you'll find some fresh enemies in hell, too.

[previewyoutube=zsxx7-BKj98;full][/previewyoutube]

Sadly, over the last year, the team behind To Hell With Hell, did fell apart for multiple personal reasons. However we did not want to abandon the game and managed to prepare a big final update with quite a lot of bugfixes and fresh content. We hope you will enjoy the new things! And we hope to meet again one day.

notes.title: To Hell with Hell: Greed Update released!
notes.notes:
The time has come. Hell is back. The demons are back. Asmodius needs your help once again. Or, in other words: One of the circles of hell has been finished: Greed is done and now available. Wait, what are we talking about? Well: Since the release of To hell with Hell we’ve been super busy, working on the first major update for the game. And it’s ready now. And the update has the name “Greed”. For a reason. It is all about greed this time, cause you will need to become greedy to get enough currency to buy yourself some cool new stuff!

[h1]New Weapons[/h1]
The most obvious change: Fresh weapons. Need a lipstick? Or want to bring on the cham-pain? Everything is possible and for those who already fell in love with the unicorn, let us tell you that To Hell with Hell became even more weird!

[h1]New enemies[/h1]
Of course. No update can be released without some fresh targets for your new weapons, right? And trust us, these new enemies are kinda spooky this time.

[h1]Welcome. To. The. Mall![/h1]
Okay. It is no mall but a shop. And with that shop, a lot of new mechanics have been implemented into To Hell with Hell.
[list]
[*]You can buy a chance that certain weapons will drop in the game
[*]You can sell masks in the shop now
[*]And you can of course sell weapons, too
[*]You can also buy potions in the shop which influence the whole gameplay and are bound to certain new achievements. For a reason.
[*]Enemies drop currency (souls) now which is persistent
[*]Added a slotmachine for some… fun
[*]New portal which directs you to the shop[/list]

[h1]New Perks & a new mask[/h1]
We have added three new perks for your playthrough, allowing you to pick new strategies. And of course we have added a new mask. The Psych is now a thing for To Hell with Hell.

[h1]Some additional changes[/h1][list]
[*]Incrased Bullet speed
[*]Increased enemies speed
[*]Increased player speed
[*]All meele weapon can reflect bullets now
[*]Increased the time till drops disappear
[*]Weapon ammo reduced by 20%
[*] Nerfed Banana weapon
[*]Items start blinking before they disappear
[*]Various gamepad fixes
[*]Added gamepad setup
[*]Added new achievements based on the potions[/list]
[h1]Boss changes[/h1][list][*]Added new attacks for first boss on further playthroughs
[*]Added new attacks for second boss on further playtghroughs[/list]
We’ve been working hard on improving the game and have implemented tons of small fixes as well. But the core feature for greed is of course the shop system. Let us know what you think, let us know how you like the potions. And let us know how you like all the new stuff we’ve been throwing into the new build.

To celebrate todays update, To Hell with Hell is 30% off for one week, also to convince some new players of course (to get some additional feedback from fresh meat so to speak).

notes.title: Patch 1.0.0.1792 Released
notes.notes:
Greetings everyone!

We have just updated [b]To Hell with Hell[/b]. The first patch contains various bugfixes but also some changes to the gameplay. During the last week, we've analyzed feedback we've got through the Forums, through [url=https://discord.gg/TKcq68]Discord[/url] and in countless streams on Twitch.

[h1]Patchnotes[/h1]
[b]Gameplay[/b]
[list][*] Third Boss spawns 5 Explosion markers now
[*]Increased the size of the Goat Mage markers
[*]Decreased the eplosion-range of the Goat Mage
[*]Increased Speed of Natasia
[*]Increased Speed of the enemies
[*]Player has one additional Mask slot uppon start
[*]Player has one additional Weapon slot uppon start
[*]Increased damage from Bow
[*]Decreased damage from Multishot Bow
[*]Increased Banana firerate and decreased damage
[*]Decreased damage time on ice, fire and poison surfaces
[*]Increased health of the second Boss
[*]Increased despawn time of items[/list]

[b]Fixes[/b]
[list][*] Fixed Particle Animations on second Boss
[*]Fixed an error which caused the first Biome to produce double traps
[*]Smaller bugfixes[/list]

[b]Features[/b]
[list][*]Added Chinese Language
[*]Autopickup added. Ammo and Health get picked up if you walk over them
[/list]

Thanks for all the feedback so far!

notes.title: The Road to Release
notes.notes:
Phew. Just two weeks left. And we'd like to give you some insights. We're currently working on the last tweaks for the Early Access build. In fact, today is our official code freeze. From now on, only bugs will be fixed. Everything which is related to new features will still be done but hold back for the first major update.

Why? Well: We don't want to break things form here on. We are feature and content complete for the Early Access (which doesn't meant we're feature and content complete for the future). And adding new stuff could easily kill the balancing, influence the game code itself or just make everything unplayable. And we prefer to have a smooth launch.

Two weeks for finetuning are hopefully enough but we're quite optimistic here. We found one gamebraking bug today and some smaller issues. But overall we have had no crashes since quite some time now, which is good sign.

On the marketing side we're currently preparing press releases and will soon send out keys to press and streamers. That means you should soon start seeing To Hell with Hell on Twitch & Youtube to get a better impression of the gameplay :)
